name: lunge-barbell-rear
title: Lunge: Barbell (Rear)
primer: This is an advanced version of a lunge.
steps: Place a barbell on a rack at chest height.
Lift the barbell off of the rack and onto your shoulders, gripping the bar slightly wider than shoulder width apart.
Stand with your feet approximately 8 inches apart with your toes pointing forward.
Slowly take a step backward with your right leg.
Keeping your abs drawn in and your upper body straight, lower your body until your right knee is almost on the ground.
Hold for a moment and then return to the starting position.
Repeat, stepping back with your left leg.
tips: You may choose to place a mat or towel under your knee.
